purpose: Identify OS profile (Windows version, architecture) from the memory image.
notes: First step for Volatility 2; Volatility 3 auto-detects.
indicators: Wrong profile = false negatives across every plugin.

purpose: Volatility 3 system information — OS, kernel, uptime, KASLR offsets.
notes: Replaces imageinfo on Vol3.

purpose: Find kernel debugger data block manual scan when imageinfo/profile fails.
notes: Useful for images with KASLR on older profiles.

purpose: List processes from the doubly-linked process list (EPROCESS).
notes: Does NOT show hidden/injected processes; compare with psscan.
indicators: Rogue processes, odd parents, unknown binaries in temp.

purpose: Scan memory pool for EPROCESS objects — finds hidden or orphaned processes.
notes: Cross-reference pslist vs psscan to detect rootkit hiding.
indicators: Processes present in psscan but absent in pslist.

purpose: Parent-child process tree with exit times.
notes: Look for orphaned processes (PPID = unlisted or exited) — classic injection/detachment.

purpose: Cross-view comparison of processes (PsActiveProcessHead, pool scan, threads, sessions, desktop).
notes: Any process False in all columns except one = likely hidden.

purpose: List loaded DLLs per process (PEB).
notes: DLLs loaded from temp/writable dirs into signed processes.
indicators: Unsigned DLLs, DLLs from AppData/Temp, missing entries.

purpose: Detect unlinked (hidden) DLLs via VAD vs PEB comparison.
notes: Entries with InLoad/InInit/InMem = False indicate DLL injection/unlinking.

purpose: Process command lines from PEB (if captured).
notes: Does not show memory-only created processes; pairs with 4688/1 Sysmon.
indicators: Malicious arguments, encoded powershell, LOLBins with payloads.

purpose: Environment variables per process.
notes: DLL search path hijacking evidence via modified PATH.
indicators: Modified PATH/APPDATA pointing to writable dirs.

purpose: Find injected code — VADs with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE + no mapped file.
notes: The primary process-injection detector; dump with --dump-dir.
indicators: RWX pages, MZ headers in unbacked regions.

purpose: List handle table per process.
notes: Find open file handles to odd paths — exfil staging or keylogging artifact files.

purpose: Enabled privileges per process.
notes: SeDebugPrivilege on non-admin-process = token meddling.

purpose: Active TCP/UDP connections incl. remote endpoints (Windows 7+ / older via pool).
notes: Pairs with Sysmon 3. Look for foreign-language locale endpoints and beacon cadence.

purpose: Older-net connection list (XP/2003).
notes: For legacy images only.

purpose: Connection object scan for terminated connections.
notes: Catches connections closed before acquisition.

purpose: Scan Windows services (including non-active ones).
notes: Services with ImagePath in temp/appdata or unknown DLLs.

purpose: Enumerate autostart locations (Run keys, services, drivers, scheduled tasks) from memory.
notes: One-shot persistence sweep; cross-check with registry plugins.

purpose: Scheduled tasks from memory.
List registry hive virtual addresses + physical offsets.
notes: Precondition for hive/printkey.

purpose: Print registry key/value (given hive offset).
notes: Manual deep-key forensics — the parsimonious way to inspect persistence.
indicators: Run keys, AppInit_DLLs, Image File Execution Options.

purpose: UserAssist GUI artifact on Windows 7+ (program execution counts/times).
notes: Reveals tools actually run by the user (mimikatz, ps, etc.).
indicators: Security tool usage by rogue user.

purpose: AppCompat shim cache (executed binaries incl. deleted).
notes: Executed-binary evidence even when 4688/1 unavailable.

purpose: Amcache application inventory (recently executed).
Extract files from disk/memory (MFT or VAD).
notes: Hash every extracted item against sandbox/AV and compute IOC hashes.

purpose: Physical-memory file object scan — every known file in the image.
notes: Find deleted binaries still resident, odd paths, staged archives.
indicators: Deleted malware files, zip/7z archives in temp.

purpose: Parse MFT entries from memory (file activity incl. deletions).
notes: Deletion/overwrite evidence; slow but thorough.

purpose: Dump SAM user hashes (NTLM/LM).
notes: Compare enabled admin accounts vs HR; crack or check hash against known leak databases (breach lookup).

purpose: LSA secrets (cached credentials, service passwords).
notes: Cached domain credentials — pivot to domain-wide check.

purpose: Cached domain credentials (MSCash).
notes: Offline cracking warmup for lateral movement analysis.

purpose: In-memory Mimikatz run against the image.
notes: Use sparingly — extracts secrets from live memory structures; hashdump is usually sufficient.

purpose: Vol3 registry hive access + key printing.
notes: Vol3 namespaced plugin names.

purpose: Vol3 service scan.
YARA scan across process memory.
notes: Scan with Cobalt Strike, mimikatz, and keylogger signatures.

purpose: Extract printable strings from memory regions.
notes: Grep for URLs, mutexes, domain names, base64 blobs.
indicators: C2 URLs, named pipes, unique mutexes.

purpose: Scan kernel mutex objects.
notes: Malware mutexes (e.g. Global\MZ-* for Qakbot) fingerprint families.

purpose: Extract screenshot(s) of desktop from memory (Windows 7+).
notes: Show what the user saw — great for briefing execs.

purpose: Generate a timeline of system activity from memory artifacts.
notes: Feed into mactime/inode2timeline for super-timeline.

purpose: Build human-readable timeline from bodyfile output.
notes: Pair with disk forensics timeline for full picture.

purpose: Vol3 process list.
Vol3 injected-code detector.
Vol3 network connections.
Vol3 process command lines.
Scan bigpool allocations (kernel driver evidence).
notes: Memory-only drivers may leave bigpool tags.

purpose: Scan loaded kernel drivers (incl. hidden).
notes: Cross-check with driver.sys catalog of signed drivers.
